people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
translations.bsb: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”
translations.kjv: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation
translations.asv: Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said, Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.
